desc: hasuimo no kuki no sunomono, thick pale green translucent pieces of taro stem dressed in vinegar with shreds of white cutlassfish, topped with myoga, in a white flower-shaped bowl
Iya no dekomawashi, bamboo skewers of small potato, brown buckwheat dumpling, firm tofu and konnyaku stacked one above another, brushed with dark miso and grilled, on a white plate
Handa somen, chilled thick-ish white somen noodles in a glass bowl with sudachi slices, red pickled ginger and green garnish, with amber dipping broth in a small glass
Iya soba, a bowl of short, broken grey-brown rustic buckwheat noodles in hot clear soy broth, topped with yellow egg threads, pink kamaboko and green onion
shusse imo, thick round slices of a roll of pale cream sweet potato wrapped in a layer of smooth dark purple-black red bean paste, two on a white plate with a leaf sprig
Awa uiro, smooth dense rectangular bars of steamed red bean and rice flour cake, matte reddish-brown, on a round pale plate with a wooden pick
hangoroshi, oval rice cakes of half-pounded rice with grains still visible, coated in golden kinako, one cut to show dark red bean paste inside, on a grey plate
oshizushi, Tokushima pressed sushi cut into rectangular slices showing layers of white yuzu vinegar rice and simmered carrot, burdock and greens, topped with orange carrot strips
mutsugoro no kabayaki, whole mudskippers grilled and simmered in sweet soy until dark glossy brown-black, with a slightly bumpy skin, laid side by side on a patterned rectangular plate
yudedago, flat round boiled wheat-flour dumplings coloured golden-tan, coated in brown sugar, sitting in a pool of dark brown sugar syrup on a white plate with blue rim
oyogoshi, a mound of creamy white mashed taro and sesame-miso dressing mixed with chopped green spinach, carrot, burdock and shiitake, in a black bowl
tsunki dago jiru, a black earthenware pot of miso soup with flat torn wheat-flour dumplings, taro chunks, eggplant, carrot and green onion

ja: 呉豆腐のごま醤油かけ
desc: kure tofu no goma joyu kake, a smooth glossy ivory-white block of soft soymilk-and-starch tofu like silken pudding, drizzled with brown sesame soy sauce, a yellow flower garnish, on a green plate
yuki no tsuyu, a bowl of miso soup filled with coarse snowy white grated daikon, with a soft toasted white mochi and boiled green spinach
kuchizoko no nitsuke, small whole flat sole fish simmered glossy dark brown in sweet soy sauce, with simmered burdock and green spinach, on an oval white plate
kuri okowa, a square red lacquered box of steamed sticky rice dotted with whole yellow chestnuts and dark red adzuki beans, topped with green sansho leaves
hoshigaki namasu, fine julienne of translucent white daikon mixed with soft orange strips of dried persimmon in sweet yuzu vinegar, a small mound in a green ceramic bowl
